newsitem.title: USA: Ashanti sees Geita equivalent of 3 mln ozs.
newsitem.headline: Ashanti sees Geita equivalent of 3 mln ozs.

text.p: Ashanti Goldfields Co Ltd on Thursday announced what it said was "a significant increase" in gold resources at its Geita property in northern Tanzania.

The company said a resource equivalent to three million ounces of contained gold had been determined, based on a recently completed 178 hole reverse circulation and core drilling programme of 19,000 metres.
The company said the figure represents a 128 percent increase on the previously reported figure.
Ashanti said it has begun a second phase drilling programme to close off the mineralised zones which remain open along strike and at depth on Nyankanga and at depth on Geita Hill and Lone Cone.

It said it will undertake infill drilling to increase the proportion of measured and indicated resource categories and do additional metallurgical testwork to confirm the non-refractory nature of the oxide and sulphide gold ores.
Ashanti Goldfields is active on 35 exploration projects in 12 African countries. Geita is the most advanced of these projects.
